Znode.Libraries.Abstract.Helper.FilterTu.description: Represents a single filter condition for querying or deleting custom table data. A FilterTuple consists of three main components: **filterName** (the column to filter on), **filterOperator** (the comparison operator), and **filterValue** (the value to compare). Multiple FilterTuple objects are combined with AND logic in filter arrays.

filterName.description: The name of the column or field in the custom table to apply the filter on. This must correspond to an actual column in the target custom table.

filterOperator.description: The comparison operator to use for filtering. **Supported values:** eq (Equals), ne (NotEquals), cn (Contains), ncn (NotContains), sw (StartsWith), ew (EndsWith), gt (GreaterThan), ge (GreaterThanOrEqual), lt (LessThan), le (LessThanOrEqual), lk (Like), nlk (NotLike), is (Is), in (In), not in (NotIn), bw (Between). The operator determines how the **filterValue** is compared against the column data.

filterValue.description: The value to compare against using the specified **filterOperator**. The format and interpretation depend on the operator and the target column's data type. For **bw** (Between) operator, use comma-separated values (e.g., '100,200'). For **in** and **not in** operators, use comma-separated values (e.g., 'value1,value2,value3').

Znode.Libraries.Abstract.Helper.CustomTa.description: Represents a single filter condition for querying the custom tables list. A FilterTuple consists of three main components: **filterName** (the field to filter on), **filterOperator** (the comparison operator), and **filterValue** (the value to compare). Multiple FilterTuple objects are combined with AND logic in filter arrays.

filterName.description: The name of the field to apply the filter on. **Supported values:** tableKey, tableName.

filterOperator.description: The comparison operator to use for filtering. **Supported values:** is (Is), cn (Contains), sw (StartsWith), ew (EndsWith), lk (Like), ncn (NotContains). Use **is** for an exact string match (case-insensitive); **eq** is not supported for these fields. The operator determines how the **filterValue** is compared against the field data.

filterValue.description: The value to compare against using the specified **filterOperator**.

item1.description: Legacy tuple property. Represents the first component of the filter tuple. This property is deprecated in favor of **filterName**, **filterOperator**, and **filterValue** properties. Included for backward compatibility.

item2.description: Legacy tuple property. Represents the second component of the filter tuple. This property is deprecated in favor of **filterName**, **filterOperator**, and **filterValue** properties. Included for backward compatibility.

item3.description: Legacy tuple property. Represents the third component of the filter tuple. This property is deprecated in favor of **filterName**, **filterOperator**, and **filterValue** properties. Included for backward compatibility.
